issues.title: Kalonzo questions Kenya’s security situation after Embu and Garissa chaos

issues.summary: Kalonzo Musyoka has raised fresh concerns over Kenya’s security situation after opposition leaders were caught up in chaos during their Garissa tour, warning that the country is at a difficult point. issues.title: Jordan pledges political backing ahead of 2027 financial crime evaluation
issues.title_en: Jordan pledges political backing ahead of 2027 financial crime evaluation
issues.summary: Jordan has affirmed high-level political commitment to preparing for the third round of mutual evaluations on anti-money laundering, counter-terrorist financing and countering proliferation financing, a process scheduled to run between 2027 and 2029.
